reply.text: {"say":"Three biceps-and-triceps supersets, each pairing one curl with one extension, done back to back with a different angle every round.","title":"Arms Supersets","days":[{"name":"Arms","exercises":[{"key":"ez-bar-biceps-curl","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"A","part":"main","note":"Elbows pinned, no swing.\u0020Control the lowering.\u0020Full stretch at bottom.\u0020Squeeze at top.\u0020Stay tall.\u0020Brace.\u0020Breathe.\u0020Go.\u0020Done.\u0020Next.\u0020Rest.\u0020Repeat.\u0020"},{"key":"ez-bar-skull-crusher","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"A","part":"main","note":"Lower behind the head, elbows in."},{"key":"dumbbell-incline-curl","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"B","part":"main","note":"Let arms hang back for a full stretch."},{"key":"cable-overhead-triceps-extension","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"B","part":"main","note":"Deep stretch overhead, lock out fully."},{"key":"dumbbell-hammer-curl","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"C","part":"main","note":"Neutral grip, slow on the way down."},{"key":"cable-rope-pushdown","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"C","part":"main","note":"Spread the rope at the bottom."}]}],"unmet":[]}
